title: The Harvest of the Undercroft
author: Ines Dunmore
blurb: Felix Halloran, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
